description: Checks and formats a phone number with libphonenumber: valid and possible flags, E.164, international and national formats, country, calling code and line type (mobile, fixed line, toll free and so on). Without a + sign, give the country. No network call. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: ISO alpha-2 default country when the number has no +, e.g. DE
